name: Smoke plume (HQ)
description: Squib's authored high-quality grey smoke plume: continuous billowing emission, rising warm smoke and persistent fine density detail.

looks.text: A close-up grey smoke texture swatch for colour and detail only; it is not a photographed room or an object to place.

prompt.subject: a neutral grey smoke plume rising from {where}
prompt.timing: smoke begins at {start}, billows by {billow}, and develops into a rising plume by {rise}
prompt.action: At {start} a continuous source at {where} releases neutral grey smoke. Warm billows rise, curl and broaden with fine persistent density detail.
prompt.sound: a soft hiss of escaping smoke
prompt.timing_preroll: a grey smoke plume is already billowing from {where} when the shot begins
prompt.action_preroll: From the first frame an established neutral grey plume rises and curls from {where}, continuously fed by the source.
